command_result.command:
pwd; git status --short; find . -name AGENTS.md -print; printf '
--- implementation ---
'; cat src/clamp.cjs; printf '
--- tests ---
'; cat test.cjs; printf '
--- package ---
'; if [ -f package.json ]; then cat package.json; fi

node test.cjs && node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const {clamp} = require("./src/clamp.cjs"); for (const [x, low, high, expected] of [[0,0,10,0],[10,0,10,10],[3,3,3,3],[-5,-10,-1,-5],[-Infinity,0,10,0],[Infinity,0,10,10]]) assert.equal(clamp(x,low,high), expected);' && diff -u <(printf '%s\n' 'exports.clamp = (x, low, high) => Math.min(low, Math.max(high, x));') src/clamp.cjs; result=$?; if [ "$result" -eq 1 ]; then test "$(cat src/clamp.cjs)" = 'exports.clamp = (x, low, high) => Math.min(high, Math.max(low, x));'; else exit "$result"; fi
